description: Miroavan wears a dark navy long wool noble coat over a cream linen shirt or tunic. Intricate gold scrolling and geometric borders trace the coat opening, cuffs and hem; dark blue embroidery decorates the under-shirt collar and vertical neckline. A dark brown leather belt with a round decorated metal buckle has a long hanging end bearing smaller circular ornaments. Dark trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the layered outfit. The blue coat sleeves are substantial but no armor is present. One hand rests near his belt while the other hangs naturally. His braided crown and shaved sides are uncovered; there is no weapon or crown.
